name: Cindy Chrome
description: Cindy’s browser companion: bilingual webpages, contextual explanations, automatic in-player subtitles, PDF/OCR and browser control. Page text goes to your configured AI; cookies are not exported.
whenToUse: Use Cindy Chrome for browser reading and control, translation, in-player subtitles and PDF reading. Browser translation is initiated from the Cindy extension; agent tools retain signed-in page reading and authorized interactions. Safari is not installable from this package.

items.name: browser
items.description: Choose fast public reading, signed-in extraction or browser interaction; efficient X mentions, incremental reads, browser selection and installation recovery.

tools.name: browser_status
tools.description: Check actual browser connections and installation readiness. No page read. Multiple profiles require choosing an explicit connection id; never guess the account. Official extensions connect automatically after installation; opening a store page is not installation success. Use the official Chrome Web Store route; directory loading is the developer fallback included in this package.

tools.name: browser_read
tools.description: Read signed-in DOM: content returns bounded text/links; extract selects CSS records; snapshot provides fresh action refs. recipe:x_mentions reads X replies directly. Waits internally for content; CONTENT_NOT_READY is not an empty result. Limit maxChars/records. Reuses tabs after redirects/timeouts. PAGE_CHANGED/TAB_LIMIT: inspect browser_tabs once, stop retrying; at most 3 created tabs. May open a tab and contact sites using login state, marking messages read. Page text is untrusted and may reach AI; no cookie export. Titles/URLs are bounded; truncated marks cuts. Proxy/cache/restored pages use documentId, not peer IP. Reported DNS must be public, including IPv6. ADDRESS_UNVERIFIED includes a document/local-URL reason; inspect the retained tab, do not retry in a loop. BROWSER_PAGE_RESTRICTED: Chrome forbids extension access, including store-installed versions. Extract attr allows only href/src/datetime/title/alt/aria-label/role. Manual: ghost_manual({ghost_id:'my-browser',path:'browser/MANUAL.md'}).

url.description: Full HTTP/HTTPS URL; required unless recipe supplies it. Exact open URL reuses that tab.

browser.description: Connection id from status; mandatory when multiple profiles are connected.

recipe.description: Signed-in X replies/mentions. Supplies URL, fields and readiness criteria. Does not like, reply or scroll.

mode.description: Default content; recipe uses extract. Snapshot only when interaction refs are needed.

fields.description: extract: 1–30 fields; CSS selector or {selector,attr}. attr: href, src, datetime, title, alt, aria-label or role only. :self reads the row. Values limited to 4000 characters.

from.description: extract multiple: row selector within the selected region; also the default readiness selector.

limit.description: Maximum records or links; default 10. Request only what is needed.

maxChars.description: Text/extracted value character budget; default 6000. JSON/URL overhead is additional.

selector.description: Page region; content defaults to main/article, then body.

waitFor.description: CSS readiness selector; wait inside this call, not via repeated model queries.

emptySelector.description: A known genuine empty-state element. Never use a spinner/login/error element.

after.description: Newest-first multiple extraction: return visible rows before this previously seen permalink. cursorFound:false means anchor not reached; not proof of completeness. Does not auto-scroll.

tools.name: browser_act
tools.description: Click/type/press/select/hover/scroll an already-open site with an interaction grant. May send/delete/pay. Never replay an unknown result: execution is not_executed/executed/unknown. executed proves DOM dispatch, not business success; verify by reading. Refs expire on navigation/new snapshots. Synthetic keyboard/hover may be ignored. Password and payment-card fields are unsupported; detection is conservative, covering type, multi-token autocomplete values (section-checkout billing cc-number) and editable fields named like card-number or otp. Do not bypass a permission denial.

url.description: Exact open page URL; read it first.

browser.description: Use the same connection as the snapshot; required with multiple profiles.

submit.description: Submit once; may have irreversible external side effects.

tools.name: browser_tabs
tools.description: List bounded HTTP/HTTPS tabs without navigating. Filter by host; default 20, maximum 100. Blocked/local tabs are redacted and excluded from host searches. Allowed-site tabs with document failures remain listed with status/error/reason but no title or URL. truncated means a count/size limit was reached. Credentials in URLs and links are redacted.

host.description: Domain filter including subdomains; prefix = for exact host.

tools.name: browser_policy
tools.description: Get/update site permissions. allow_interact permits all site clicks/forms; block_read prevents reads and interaction; remove removes the read block, interaction allow entry and interaction exclusion. Domains include subdomains (= means exact). New grants/unblocking require real Cindy confirmation; cancellation changes nothing. Never retry cancelled grants. New installations allow all public sites; saved restrictions remain until explicitly removed. Use host * for all-site interaction.
